answer: Resist Sybils with stake-backed vouching plus costly identity minting. The network is a frozen tundra for fakes: every new agent must be vouched for by an existing member who locks collateral, slashed if the newcomer proves fake. Each identity also needs a small proof-of-work — one climber per ledge is cheap, but ten thousand fake climbers is ruinous. A behavioral anomaly signal triggers audits; proven fakes are burned with their vouchers’ stakes. The attacker’s cost scales linearly per fake identity in compute plus locked capital, while an honest agent pays once and climbs freely.
